20230301.text: Without a Travel Permit, you cannot enter or leave Ritou.

20230302.text: It seems if you do not have a Travel Permit, you cannot freely enter or leave the island.

20230401.text: Without a Travel Permit, you cannot enter or leave Ritou.

20230402.text: It seems if you do not have a Travel Permit, you cannot freely enter or leave the island.

20230403.text: According to our agreement, we'll get that Travel Permit once we <color=#00E1FFFF>deliver Miss Chisato's letter</color>, right?

735260201.text: My most important partners, you're back! How did the Barking Fox's controls feel to you? Was the flight envelope broad enough?

735260203.text: The Barking Fox wasn't difficult to control at all! It was actually pretty fun! But about that technical jargon of yours... Paimon doesn't know how to answer that!

735260204.text: Hmm... Your response would be best classified into the "user could not accurately describe their feedback" category — but that's pretty common and not a big deal at all!

735260205.text: No matter how many tries it takes, as long as you complete the test challenges without making personal modifications to the Barking Fox, then its flight performance is at the expected level!

735260207.text: #That sounds complicated! {NICKNAME} doesn't understand anything like that either!

735260233.text: Huh? Really? Paimon thought it was okay...

735260234.text: #Looks like {NICKNAME}'s become a harsh critic after testing so many people's inventions.

735260235.text: Negative feedback!? I can't believe it... Could you please tell me what's wrong?

735260243.text: Oh, right! If you call yourself the Phantom Toy Master, you must have really amazing... um... design experience? Is that how you say it?

735260244.text: And you seem to know all about... investments? You're always talking about huge sums of Mora! You must have made a ton of money before!

735260247.text: What's wrong!? You look like you're about to die of pain!

735260248.text: No! I will never die of anguish! If I am to die... I will die extremely wealthy, due to overindulging in every luxury imaginable!

735260249.text: Only the regret of missing out on a business opportunity can harm me! I even survived traveling on foot in the desert... for three whole months!

735260250.text: Those awful debt collectors who forced me to flee into the desert will never understand! But mark my words, my innovations will one day be turned into Mora!

735260266.text: Huh!? You still haven't gotten enough? That means flying the Barking Fox is really fun! That's great! It's a design success!

735270201.text: Distinguished guests, would you like to play Spino Blaster now?

735270203.text: No problem! Please, blast away to your heart's content!

735270205.text: Yeah! We imagined we were just like... gunners on a huge battleship! We were unleashing salvo after salvo, those targets didn't stand a chance!

735270206.text: But now that Paimon thinks about it... do real ship gunners have to aim at so many targets in such a short time, too? That's really tough...

735270207.text: Precisely so! Now you understand the original inspiration behind the game!

735270208.text: Shells don't fly in a straight line but arcs. Gunners must raise the cannon to hit faraway targets...

735270209.text: At the same time, the ship will be rocking on the waves, so the gunner must adjust the cannon vertically to compensate for the pitch and roll.

735270210.text: For all of those reasons, gunners must be extremely proficient in determining the proper elevation of the cannon barrel in order to be able to properly aim in all situations.

735270211.text: Of course, it's also essential to learn how to lead properly in order to hit fast-moving targets. The faster the target and the slower the shell, the more difficult it is to predict how much to lead.

735270212.text: That's why I invented the Crocomorph Vortex-Based Crocodilian-Armored Heavy Naval Battleship-Style Water Blasting Training Cannon! The speed and cost of ammo are both quite low.

735270213.text: By placing the cannon on a rocking, floating platform and using balloon targets, superb gunners can be quickly trained, greatly increasing the battle prowess of the entire fleet!

735270229.text: Wonderful, seems like this game has captured your interest!

735270230.text: The basic idea is simply for you to enjoy yourself, so it isn't very difficult yet...

735270231.text: But if you get good at it and feel ready for a challenge, just be patient. I'll add some new wrinkles and twists to it as soon as possible!

735270233.text: Oh yeah, Paimon is curious about your past too... Why did you think about making a game out of water cannons?

735270234.text: Oh, that's simple! My old job was related to cannons.

735270235.text: A very long time ago, I was a weapon engineer for Fontaine's fleet. My wife and daughter were both excellent gunners serving on the flagship.

735270236.text: You could say my whole family is quite familiar with cannons!

735270237.text: My wife and daughter often gave me firsthand feedback. Thanks to their expertise, I became an outstanding engineer, and was elevated to work on some impressive projects.

735270238.text: I was often away from home testing weapons. Incidentally, the desert has a lot of empty spaces to test cannons and shells, so I became a frequent visitor.

735270239.text: However, in one field test, we neglected to store the shells and detonators separately, and there was a massive explosion...

735270240.text: The team suffered grievous losses. I was tossed away like a ragdoll, and I count myself lucky to have survived, though I laid in that forsaken desert in a coma for days!

735270266.text: Yes, you seem quite busy, I understand. I'll be here waiting, come back whenever you have time!

735280201.text: A-hmm-hmm-hmm~ Now you've played Bing-Bang Finchball, have you not? Now do you agree with me when I say that finches are the cutest?

735280203.text: Ohoho! That's true, nobody should leave after just playing one round of Finchball! Play to your heart's content!

735280205.text: Yep! Paimon couldn't tell by just reading the rules, but once Paimon started playing, Paimon found out the game was really fun!

735280206.text: Hold the Finchball in your palm, and feel its unique round design! Then, study it closely, and you discover incredible details you never expected...

735280207.text: After that, you won't be able to resist trying to recall what real finches look like, and comparing them...

735280208.text: Your reactions are amazing! This is exactly why I designed this game!

735280209.text: If this game catches on in Teyvat, it'll spark a wave of finch fever! People everywhere will want to share their lives with a precious finch by their side!

735280210.text: Perhaps there will even be finch cafes, finch taverns, and even finch hotels! That way, even those who cannot raise a finch of their own can still bask in their radiant cuteness.

735280211.text: The sheer adorableness of finches would supercharge everyone's spirits with love, people would become more patient, and the world would have fewer arguments...

735280212.text: With time, Teyvat would become a land of peace! That's why I have to work hard on this game!

735280229.text: Shh, keep it down! Even Paimon... can get embarrassed sometimes!

735280230.text: Haha, this I will admit! Now that I look more closely, your floating white companion is every bit as adorable as a finch!

735280231.text: The tiny body, the carefree attitude, the fluffy white hair, the chubby round cheeks, the big watery eyes like crystals and a delightfully colorful costume with naught a speck of dust or blemish...

735280232.text: Ordinary folk like me would never encounter such a wondrous traveling companion! Honored guest, you must be one in a million... no, a billion, to have such a friend!

735280233.text: So, in the eyes of most people, perhaps we should say... "If you don't count the extraordinary Paimon, finches are the cutest!"

735280249.text: Yes, what exactly is "cute"? Your seemingly casual question actually brings us to essential and critical debates on definition.

735280250.text: Do certain shapes and colors form images that impact our psychology via our vision, and thus create this sensation?

735280251.text: Or do certain tones and pitches form sounds that reverberate inside us, creating a resonance with our feelings?

735280252.text: Thousands of papers can be written on the definition of "cute," and the academic world could debate it for decades...

735280253.text: Hahaha, but debates like those become a battle of academic resources! It is not reason and truth that wins, but power and position!

735280254.text: I suggest that you stay out debates like that, else you might end up like me... wasting years, losing the debate in the end, and offending an entire cafe worth of scholars...

735280255.text: Then my days at the Akademiya became a nightmare... I was dispatched into the desert with nothing but a small pack of provisions for a survey on mysterious creatures and almost died of hunger and thirst...

735280263.text: No problem! I believe that, when you have traveled across all of Teyvat and seen all manner of creatures, you will come back and tell me that you agree with me!

735290201.text: Honored warriors, the shift in your auras suggests... you are supremely confident in your battle results, and your blade dance was a masterful performance for the ages!

735290203.text: Such dauntless courage! Then please, continue to dance upon the field of battle!

735290206.text: Even prior to you dancing the blade dance, your aura is already blindingly powerful. I cannot imagine how intimidating you will be after defeating these enemies!

735290207.text: Paimon thinks "intimidating" is a bit too much... It's not like we go around threatening people... Unless it's to give bad guys a warning!

735290208.text: #No matter how strong we become, {NICKNAME} is going to be just as kind, happy, super patient, and winsome as always!

735290209.text: And almost nobody but you has ever said we felt... intimidating or something!

735290210.text: Yes, that is exactly it! Forgive my shallow description! I remember reading something similar in novels... ahem, strategy materials from Liyue and Inazuma—

735290211.text: You have already far surpassed "using your imposing aura to suppress potential enemies and avoid combat"! You have reached an even more transcendent level!

735290212.text: It is exactly because you have no equals that you choose to appear as a completely meek and weak mortal... like even a Boar could take you out.

735290213.text: But when you run into those harboring ill intentions, you will immediately understand their intent, and acting completely casually, you will observe their every move...

735290214.text: "Whatever. But the moment you bare your weapon is the moment of your doom."

735290220.text: Oh, right... Based on how you dress, you're from... Mondstadt?

735290221.text: The nature of your question is recognition of my supreme abilities in the art of disguise.

735290222.text: In fact, I am from Fontaine, and I write novels for a living... Hmm, or should I say, apart from being the Blade Dancer, I write heroic novels for some extra pocket money in my spare time.

735290223.text: You're from Fontaine? You really don't look like it!

735290224.text: I dress like a Mondstadter because I once traveled there for a period of time. The clothes are comfortable and convenient. They conceal my identity too...

735290225.text: When there are not terrible foes with which to waltz the dance of blades, it is wise to hide your weapons and keep a low profile.

735290226.text: Or else the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, or even the Marechaussee Phantom...

735290227.text: Ahem! Or else, some strange law enforcement officer will find you, disarm you, and make sure you don't intend to harm the city.

735290228.text: They are lithe as cats, fast as the wind, and where they have passed, a unique scent of the sea and algae lingers...

735290229.text: What are you talking about... some kind of fairy-tale creature? Sounds like an excuse for past failures!

735290230.text: Anyway, I suggest you don't mess with the law in Fontaine, they can be very difficult...

735290231.text: Of course, if you must do something in the name of conscience... then you must steel yourself in advance. You must prepare to leave Fontaine with no regrets, so as not to be arrested!

735290233.text: You two... I see it clearly! You have entered the optimal state to begin the battle dance, and I should not disturb you... I look forward to another graceful performance!
